answer: Each challenge commits to a domain-separated hash of the agent identity, task nonce, and a future threshold-BLS beacon pulse. Since the pulse is collectively generated and revealed only after submission, its unpredictable, unbiasable value binds evaluation and cannot be chosen by a claimant. Precomputed answers, offline farming, and cloned sybil identities therefore lose reuse value; a wander, relic, or bridge label is only metadata, never usable entropy.
